access_boundary: This record represents the deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1 repository release at commit 56d4cbbb4d29f4355bab4b9a39ccb717a14ad5ad (last modified 2025-03-27). DeepSeek-R1-Zero, the six distilled models, the separate DeepSeek-R1-0528 repository, downstream quantizations, and the DeepSeek API remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Developer-published Safetensors shards, tokenizer, and modeling code with a repository MIT license file that the model card applies to the weights
The model card distinguishes DeepSeek-R1 from DeepSeek-R1-Zero and the distilled variants and names vLLM and SGLang as self-operated serving paths
tradeoffs: The model card's self-hosting examples target the distilled models, and the very large full checkpoint narrows practical self-operation
The 0528 update is a separate repository and DeepSeek's API change log shows this release is no longer served first-party, so lifecycle facts live outside the model card
